mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4, which may increase vitamin E levels; vitamin E at high doses may potentiate anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk, particularly relevant in HIV patients on concurrent anticoagulation.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding if high-dose vitamin E (>400 IU/day) is used concurrently; consider lower vitamin E doses or alternative supplementation; counsel patient on bleeding precautions.
